company.name: Notion
company.oneLiner: The AI workspace where teams and agents capture knowledge, find answers and automate busywork — docs, wikis, projects and Custom Agents in one connected system.
company.description: Notion started as an all-in-one workspace built from flexible blocks and has become an AI workspace: a system of record for a team's knowledge, with Notion AI search across connected apps and Custom Agents that run workflows. It is free for individuals and grows into Business and Enterprise plans for companies like OpenAI, Ramp, Figma and Vercel.
company.stage: Scaled leader — 100M users in 50+ countries, 50% of YC companies

audience.primary: Teams at ambitious tech companies who want one place for docs, projects and AI
audience.buyer: Founders, heads of operations and IT leaders consolidating tools
audience.user: Everyone on the team — PMs, engineers, designers, ops — plus individuals for personal projects

jobsToBeDone: Bring everything into one system of record
Get answers with citations across connected apps
Run projects, docs and wikis without tool sprawl
differentiators: Flexible building blocks — 'solve your problems your way'
AI that works where the team's knowledge already lives
A humane, crafted brand in a utilitarian category

positioning.statement: For teams drowning in tabs and tools, Notion is the one workspace where knowledge, projects and AI agents live together — so work moves without the duct tape of emails, copy/paste and countless tabs.
positioning.promise: One tool to run your company.

pillars.description: One system of record for docs, wikis and projects.

pillars.name: Find answers
pillars.description: AI search across the workspace and connected apps, with citations.

pillars.name: Automate busywork
pillars.description: Custom Agents that keep work moving 24/7.

personality.summary: Notion is a tool with a sketchbook. The product UI is crisp and black-and-white; around it, hand-drawn characters, a playful pill word and a founder's letter that starts 'Hi there!' make it feel made by people who love tools, history and art. It is confident enough to be simple — big black headlines, few colors — and warm enough to wink.
personality.archetype: The Maker — a craftsperson's workshop where anyone can build their own tools.

traits.description: Short headlines ('AI where your team works.') and a nearly monochrome palette — but every surface is full of real product.
Hand-drawn people, the rotating 'Jam/Create' pill, a 👈 in the careers copy — personality in small doses.
The about page cites Alan Kay, Doug Engelbart and Ted Nelson; the footer quotes McLuhan in a serif.
'One tool to run your company.' — declarative, with proof (100M users, G2 #1) never shouted.

voice.summary: Plain, short and friendly. Headlines are four-word sentences with periods; body copy is conversational (reading grade ~7) and speaks to the team as 'you' and 'your team'. The brand allows itself a little warmth and history, but product copy stays crisp: verbs + nouns ('Capture knowledge', 'Find answers', 'Automate busywork').

principles.name: Say it in four words
principles.description: Headlines are short declarative sentences with a period.
principles.dont: Revolutionize your team's productivity with cutting-edge AI-powered workflows

principles.name: Verb + noun
principles.description: Capabilities are named as actions people take.

principles.name: Human first, product second
principles.description: Talk about teams, people and their day before features.
principles.do: Where teams and agents jam together.
principles.dont: Agentic AI platform for enterprise knowledge management

principles.name: Proof without pomp
principles.description: Numbers appear as quiet facts in small type.

mechanics: Sentence case everywhere; headlines often end with a period.
Arrows (→) on links and secondary CTAs.
Primary CTA always names the product: 'Get Notion free'.
Emoji only in personal, founder-voice copy — never in product UI copy.

visual.summary: Black ink on white and warm off-white, set in heavy, tightly tracked Inter; a single blue for action; real product UI as the main image; and a hand-drawn character world plus duotone customer photography for warmth. Color appears in small, functional moments — tags, the pill word, customer cards.

principles.name: Heavy, tight headlines
principles.description: Inter 700 at 54–96px with −0.035 to −0.048em tracking and ~1.04 leading; the headline is the loudest thing on the page.

principles.name: The product is the picture
principles.description: Real Notion pages (meetings, dashboards, tasks, agents) staged on warm #F6F5F4 cards.

principles.name: Sketchbook warmth
principles.description: Hand-drawn black-line characters and doodles sit on top of crisp UI — never the other way round.

principles.name: Color as a highlighter
principles.description: Blue #0075DE for CTAs; saturated red/blue/yellow appear only as duotone customer cards, tags and the inline pill.

principles.name: Serif for the human voice
principles.description: Lyon Text is reserved for quotes and editorial moments (testimonials, the McLuhan quote).

visual.colorUsage: White and warm off-white (#F6F5F4) dominate; near-black ink (#000 / #1A1A1A) sets type and illustration line; Notion Blue (#0075DE) is the only action color; red #F64932, yellow #FFB110 and blue tints appear as content color, not chrome.
visual.typography: Inter (as NotionInter) for everything UI and marketing: 700 for headlines with aggressive negative tracking, 400/500 for body at 16/1.5. Lyon Text serif for quotes. No mono in marketing.
visual.layout: Centered hero, then left-aligned sections on a wide 1380px canvas; bento-style feature cards with a small label, a bold title and a real UI crop; generous gaps.
visual.imagery: Real product UI; black-line hand-drawn characters and doodles; duotone-tinted customer photography in primary-ish hues; logo walls in monochrome.
visual.iconography: Simple solid glyphs and emoji-like colored page icons inside the product; arrows for navigation.
visual.shape: Rounded but not bubbly: 5px inputs, 8px buttons, 12px cards; pills for tags and the hero word.
do: Set headlines in Inter 700 with −0.035em tracking and tight leading.
Show real Notion pages, not abstract illustrations of 'productivity'.
Use hand-drawn black-line characters for warmth around the product.
Reserve Notion Blue for the primary CTA.
dont: Don't add gradients or glows — Notion is flat.
Don't use more than one accent color in chrome; color belongs to content.
Don't use the serif for headlines or UI.

motion.summary: Motion is subtle and functional: 150–200ms ease transitions on hover and menus, a rotating verb in the hero pill, and product UI that animates like the real app. No WebGL, no scroll-jacking.

principles.name: Feel like the app
principles.description: Marketing motion mirrors in-product micro-interactions — quick, ease-out, undramatic.

principles.name: One playful moment
principles.description: The hero's rotating verb pill is the only flourish; everything else stays calm.

motion.signature: The hero pill that cycles verbs — 'Where teams and agents Jam / Create together.'
